programme.title: How the Ryder Cup Was Won
programme.desc: A look back at the story of The 2010 Ryder Cup at Celtic Manor, which took place in Wales. Colin Montgomerie's European side went into the tournament looking to win back the famous trophy.

programme.title: Rocket Mortgage Classic, PGA Tour Golf
programme.desc: Highlights from across the Rocket Mortgage Classic, held at the Detroit Golf Club. This is just the third time that this PGA Tour event has taken place.

programme.title: Golf Academy
programme.desc: Professional golfers give advice on how to improve your game from the tee to the green. Here, former Masters winner Bernhard Langer on how to best use the driver.

programme.title: Golf Academy
programme.desc: Professional golfers give advice on how to improve your game across all aspects, from the tee to the green. Here, Paul McGinley on improving your short game.

programme.title: School of Golf
programme.desc: The School of Golf offers tips and tricks on how to improve your golfing game. Here, take inspiration from a selection of iconic shots.

programme.title: School of Golf
programme.desc: Martin Hall and Blair O'Neal take the fear out of golf's scariest shots.

programme.title: Women's British Open Official Film
programme.desc: The best of the action from day four of the AIG Women's British Open from the famous Royal Troon in Scotland. Past champions of this event include Georgia Hall and Catriona Matthew.

programme.title: Women's British Open Official Film
programme.desc: The story of the 2021 AIG Women's Open, as several players vied for the title right down to the final green.

programme.title: Women's British Open Official Film
programme.desc: Reflect on the events that unfolded at Muirfield in August 2022 – the first time the historic golf course in East Lothian staged the Women's Open.

programme.title: Women's British Open Official Film
programme.desc: The official film of the 2024 Women's Open, held at the home of golf in St Andrews, Scotland. It would be a fairy-tale week for Lydia Ko, who added Open glory to Olympic gold.

programme.title: Women's Open Official Film 2025
programme.desc: The official film of the 2025 AIG Women's Open. Taking place at Royal Porthcawl in Wales, Japan's Miyu Yamashita claimed victory - finishing two shots clear at the summit.

programme.title: Chevron Championship LPGA Golf
programme.desc: The concluding day of the Chevron Championship - the first women's Major on the 2026 calendar. It took a five-way playoff to determine last year's winner - Mao Saigo.

programme.title: US Women's Open, LPGA Tour Golf
